rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the television medium and for watching television generally.

example.english: I usually have the television on while eating.
example.traditional: 我平時食飯會開住電視。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 si4 sik6 faan6 wui5 hoi1 zyu6 din6 si6

rows.note: Use this when you mean the physical television set or appliance.

example.english: The television set at home is broken, so I can't watch the match.
example.traditional: 屋企部電視機壞咗，睇唔到波。
example.jyutping: uk1 kei2 bou6 din6 si6 gei1 waai6 zo2 tai2 m4 dou2 bo1

rows.note: Use this when you mean the programs themselves rather than television as a medium in general.

example.english: This television program is great for children to watch.
example.traditional: 呢個電視節目好啱細路仔睇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 din6 si6 zit3 muk6 hou2 ngaam1 sai3 lou6 zai2 tai2
